paragraphs: A fake video circulating on social media fraudulently used Euronews branding to claim that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s parents are under corruption investigation.

The video falsely claimed that Ukraine’s Anti-Corruption Bureau discovered millions of dollars in their bank account and that they were briefly arrested. However, fact-checkers confirmed that Euronews never produced this report, and pointed out that the narrator’s voice was generated by AI.

Ukraine’s officials identified the video as part of a Russian disinformation campaign that creates fake news using respected media logos to discredit Ukraine on the international stage and reduce support from foreign allies during the ongoing war. Experts noted that there have been similar deepfakes and fabricated stories targeting Zelenskyy and his family in the past.

paragraphs: A viral video on social media falsely claims that the parents of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy are in trouble for corrupt money. The video uses the logo of a famous news channel, but the story is completely fake.

Fact-checkers found that Euronews didn’t make this video, and the voice in it was made by AI. Ukrainian officials explained that this video is part of Russian propaganda to share fake news. The main goal of these fake stories is to make people around the world lose trust in Ukraine and stop helping the country. There were many similar fake reports about the Zelenskyy family before

paragraphs: A popular video on the internet tells a bad story about President Zelenskyy’s parents. It says that they take a lot of money illegally.

This story is fake. The creators use a logo from a real news company, but the news company does not make it. The voice in the video comes from a computer. Officials say that Russian teams make this fake video to start more problems for Ukraine. They want other countries to stop helping Ukraine.
Fact-checkers already check many stories like this in the past. There are many similar videos which want to hurt Ukraine.

a person or team who checks if information is correct and true
